Lena reads November
Lena leads sales at Northwind. On the last day of the month she opens Insights to see how the team's 130 bookings went, before Thursday's team meeting.
Filters
Pick the team and the dates
Lena switches from her own account to Northwind Sales and sets the range to Month to date. The dates count by booking start time unless she picks Created at.
Performance and Events
The month in two cards
Performance shows ratings, no-shows and CSAT against October. Events splits November's 130 bookings into completed, upcoming, rescheduled and cancelled.
Event trends
Day by day
Event trends draws the bookings scheduled each day and the ones that got cancelled. Lena turns the other lines off in the legend to keep the chart readable.
Members and links
Who took the calls, and which ones
Lena took the most bookings, 44. Tobias, the newest rep, tops Most cancelled with 4. Discovery call is the busiest link with 84 bookings.
Routing
Where the form sent people
The Routing tab follows the Talk to sales form: 112 responses, 84 with a booking, and how many calls each rep got per week. Lena asks Tobias to look at his cancellations on Thursday.

Questions about Insights
What the numbers count, and who sees them.
Ask a question
What does Insights show?
Your bookings over a date range: Performance (average rating, host and guest no-shows, CSAT), the Events breakdown, Event trends, the most and least booked members, the most cancelled and no-show hosts, popular links, booking hours, durations, and cancellation and reschedule reasons.
Who can use Insights?
Anyone on a team. Insights reads team bookings, so an account without a team sees an upgrade page instead. You can switch between your own account and each team you belong to.
How are the numbers counted?
Total events counts every booking in the range. Upcoming is what's left once completed, rescheduled and cancelled are taken out. Host no-shows count per booking, guest no-shows per attendee, and CSAT is the share of ratings above 3.
What does "from last period" compare against?
The same length of time just before your range. For November month to date, that's October.
Can I filter by member or link?
Yes. Add a filter for a member, a link, booking status, paid bookings, user name or email, or rating, and every card counts again. Dates can follow the booking's start time or when it was created.
Does it cover routing forms?
Yes. The Routing tab shows each form's responses with and without a booking, the routing funnel, who got routed to per day, week or month, and failed bookings by field. You can download the data as a CSV.
